detailZones.title: Washing station
detailZones.description: Inspect the pre-rinse spray, sink bowls, drainboards, faucets, splashbacks, dispensers and handwash basin.

detailZones.title: Cooking line
detailZones.description: Explore the extraction hood, range, oven, kettle, burner controls, flues, guards and mobile rack.

detailZones.title: Preparation islands
detailZones.description: Inspect the preparation tables, colour-coded boards, produce trays, mixer, processor, scales and stored pans.

detailZones.title: Cold storage and back wall
detailZones.description: Explore the cold-room door, upright chiller, storage rack, containers, stockpots, microwave and cleaning tools.

detailZones.title: Meal service pass
detailZones.description: Inspect the dining-room opening, heated serving counter, food wells, insulated carrier and service lighting.

detailZones.title: Mobile storage and utilities
detailZones.description: Follow the service trolley, plates, covered pans, waste bins, floor drain, table shelves and utility fittings.

anchorAudit.rationale: The generated source and final JPEG were inspected at native and final pixels. This scene retains 150 independently pointable objects and visible parts across 6 bounded zones. People, identity, readable text, brands, hidden contents, inferred processes and unsupported states were excluded.
